summary: Iteration 2 testing of ArchEsame (focus Urbanistica, Design questions, Search, Favorites, Simulation). Backend: 34/34 pytest tests PASS (18 regression from iteration 1 + 16 new). urbanistica now has 8 topics and 28 questions. GET /api/topics/search returns correct topics for 'perequazione' (3 results) and is case-insensitive; empty q returns []. GET /api/design-questions and ?category=urbanistica return 6 items with fields did/category/titolo/prompt/guida (note: Italian field name is 'titolo', not 'title'). GET /api/quiz/simulation count-clamped to [5,40], supports ?category=urbanistica, returns qid/options/correct/explanation. POST /api/quiz/submit still works and persists mistakes. All 6 new urbanistica topics return deep content (piani-attuativi, opere-urbanizzazione-oneri, perequazione-compensazione, vincoli-esproprio, rigenerazione-consumo-suolo, parametri-edilizi-urbanistici). Frontend (mobile viewport 390x844): Studia header has lib-search-btn + lib-favorites-btn. /search page: input works and returns 3 results for 'perequazione'. /favorites: shows empty state 'Nessun preferito' then displays the saved topic after toggling topic-favorite-button on /topic/perequazione-compensazione. /practice: 4 segments present (Quiz/Flashcard/Progett./Tracce) + practice-simulation-banner; Progett. shows expandable design-dq-0..5 cards with 'SVOLGIMENTO GUIDATO'. /simulation: setup (sim-count-10/20/30, sim-all/sim-urban, sim-start) → running (sim-option-N, sim-next) → esito screen with punteggio and sim-again/sim-exit all working end-to-end. No red screens, no console errors.
action_items: No blocking issues. Pre-existing low-prio polish from iteration 1 (Italian pluralization '1 argomenti'; Enter-to-send on Tutor TextInput) still open — optional.
Review request mentioned design-question field 'titolo'; UI uses 'titolo' correctly. If an English alias is desired for consistency, expose both 'titolo' and 'title' in the API response.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py: /topics/search uses case-insensitive regex $or on title/subtitle/content/key_points — correct and matches the review spec. Empty q short-circuits to [] on the server (defense-in-depth over client ≥2 chars rule).
/quiz/simulation clamps count to [5,40] — good guard against abuse.
Seeding is versioned (CONTENT_VERSION=3) with upsert by stable qid/fid/tid/did — safe for repeated restarts and preserves AI-generated questions.
All list/detail endpoints project {_id: 0} — no ObjectId leaks.

frontend: topic-favorite-button on topic/[slug] correctly reads/writes via src/favorites.ts; /search debounces client-side ≥2 chars; /simulation uses countdown timer and single-shot /quiz/submit per answer.
